confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of southern French price levels, not checked against live menus or listings. Cafe and restaurant anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation is least certain because the July window overlaps the Festival d'Avignon, which can push room rates well above normal July levels, so these are blended rather than festival-peak figures. Cocktail and wine_glass were set relative to the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.3x beer, wine glass about 1.1x beer) because direct bar-price knowledge is limited. USD values assume roughly 1.15 USD per EUR. The FX observation (0.6955 on 2026-10-15) was consistent across two rba.gov.au-restricted searches; the F11 table itself was not read directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-sized southern French tourist cities in Provence and the lower Rhone, such as Arles and Nimes, for cafes, restaurants and drinks. Accommodation adjusted upward for July Festival d'Avignon demand.
